behavior: --pij is available through shared query arguments for sources, sessions, turns, messages, tools, and events, but never native list/export/Git Notes routes.
Pij requests retain a validated QueryCommand with an injected cwd repository scope and cannot be executed as ordinary ParsedCommand::Query values before PM resolution.
SessionShow and SourceCheck carry explicit pending targets using temporary List operations; Query preserves its requested operation.
Pij turn ranges are retained while parser validation temporarily excludes only the unresolved-session range constraint.
Resolved continuation actions use explicit SourceId and exact session EntityId, never the live Pij alias.
--min-duration accepts finite nonnegative decimal milliseconds and emits FieldValue::Float with Predicate::AtLeast.
Raw summaries expose QueryResponse coverage, universe, CSV format losses, JSON/JSONL recovery formats, and raw spreadsheet formula risk on stderr.
Typed input/query contract failures exit 2; source/read/cursor/limit/output failures and diagnostic write failures exit 1.
